name: mcp-server-template
description: Secure MCP server template in TypeScript and Python: stdio by default, optional streamable HTTP behind bearer auth, rate limit and body cap, bound to 127.0.0.1; bounded file and network access with allowlists and SSRF protection; redacting JSON logs; health tool; tests, non-root pinned Docker images, Semgrep, gitleaks, CodeQL, SBOMs.
